    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int t = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = t;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int l, int r) {
        while (l < r) {
            swap(arr, l++, r--);
        }
    }

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    enum Weapon {
        B1(1, 0), B2(2, 1), B3(0, 2);
        final int first;
        final int second;

        Weapon(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class State {
        int[] a;
        int[] b;

        State(int[] a, int[] b) {
            this.a = a.clone();
            this.b = b.clone();
        }

        void attack(Weapon w) {
            int i = w.ordinal();
            if (b[i] > a[w.first]) {
                b[i] -= a[w.first];
                a[w.first] = 0;
                if (b[i] > a[w.second]) {
                    b[i] -= a[w.second];
                    a[w.second] = 0;
                } else {
                    a[w.second] -= b[i];
                    b[i] = 0;
                }
            } else {
                a[w.first] -= b[i];
                b[i] = 0;
            }
        }

        int remaining() {
            return a[0] + a[1] + a[2];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int[] a = {in.nextInt(), in.nextInt(), in.nextInt()};
        int[] b = {in.nextInt(), in.nextInt(), in.nextInt()};

        int max = Math.min(a[0], b[1]) + Math.min(a[1], b[2]) + Math.min(a[2], b[0]);

        Weapon[][] orders = {
            {Weapon.B1, Weapon.B2, Weapon.B3},
            {Weapon.B1, Weapon.B3, Weapon.B2},
            {Weapon.B2, Weapon.B1, Weapon.B3},
            {Weapon.B2, Weapon.B3, Weapon.B1},
            {Weapon.B3, Weapon.B2, Weapon.B1},
            {Weapon.B3, Weapon.B1, Weapon.B2}
        };

        int minAns = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Weapon[] order : orders) {
            State state = new State(a, b);
            for (Weapon w : order) {
                state.attack(w);
            }
            minAns = Math.min(minAns, state.remaining());
        }

        System.out.println(minAns + " " + max);
    }
}
